| # Object 0x1016 heartbeat consumer entries {#object-0x1016-heartbeat-consumer-entries-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                                            |                                                                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The consumer heartbeat time defines the expected heartbeat cycle time and thus has to be higher than

the corresponding producer heartbeat time configured on the device producing this heartbeat.

 

  Index         0x1016
  ------------- ----------------------------
  Name          Heartbeat Consumer Entries
  Object        ARRAY
  Data Type     UNSIGNED 32
  Category      Optional
  PDO Mapping   No

 

 

SubIndex Supported

 

  SubIndex        0
  --------------- -------------------
  Description     number of entries
  Access          RO
  Value Range     NA
  Default Value   0x20

 

 

  SubIndex        1-32
  --------------- ------------------------------
  Description     Consumer heartbeat Time 1-32
  Access          RW
  Value Range     UNSIGNED 32
  Default Value   0

 

 

Object Entry description:

  ------------------- ---------------------- ----------- ----------------
  Bits                31-24                  23-16       15-0
  Description/Value   reserved(value: 00h)   Node-ID     Heartbeat time
  Encoded as          \-                     UNSIGNED8   UNSIGNED16
  ------------------- ---------------------- ----------- ----------------
